standard_prerequisites.name: Uniqueness of the classes obtained by capping with the Chern classes, determined by a single equation on the projective bundle
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Same chapter chow.tex, label lemma-determine-intersections (invoked at proof line 7374)
standard_prerequisites.use: It shows that the collections $\alpha_j = c_j(\mathcal{E}) \cap \alpha$ and $\beta_j = c_j(\mathcal{E}) \cap \beta$ are each uniquely determined by the same equation in the chow group of $\mathbf{P}(\mathcal{E})$.

standard_prerequisites.name: Compatibility of flat pullback with rational equivalence
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Same chapter chow.tex, label lemma-flat-pullback-rational-equivalence (invoked at proof line 7380)
standard_prerequisites.use: It guarantees that the images of the rationally equivalent cycles $\alpha$ and $\beta$ in the projective bundle satisfy the same equation, so that the uniqueness applies.

core_obligations: Pass to the projective bundle associated to $\mathcal{E}$ and recall the equation whose solutions are the classes $c_j(\mathcal{E}) \cap \alpha$ (proof lines 7374-7378).
Justify that the equation is literally the same for $\alpha$ and $\beta$, using that flat pullback is compatible with rational equivalence (proof lines 7378-7380).
Conclude that the solutions coincide, which is the assertion (proof line 7380).
proof_roadmap: The determining equation on the projective bundle (proof lines 7374-7378).
Rational equivalence preserved by flat pullback (proof lines 7378-7380).
difficulty_reason: The lemma states that capping a cycle with a Chern class of a finite locally free sheaf depends only on the rational equivalence class of the cycle, so that these caps are well defined operations on Chow groups (statement lines 7363-7371). The proof transfers the question to the projective bundle, where the capped classes are uniquely determined by a single equation, and uses that flat pullback respects rational equivalence so that both sides satisfy the same equation. The transfer and the appeal to uniqueness are the substance, so the claim is H2.
